findings.detail: _persisted_cache_path (reckon/metadata_index.py:1859) files each entry at <config home>/cache/plan-review-snapshot-evidence/<digest>-v1.json, and the entry carries the full _prose_texts mapping for the plan, so each distinct reviewed snapshot content leaves a permanent file sized with the plan's prose. Growth is bounded by distinct reviewed plan versions rather than by read count, and unchanged plans share one entry, so this is small in practice; it is recorded because reckon/crew/gc.py:414 prunes the pick-input cache and the ledger index cache while adding no sweep for cache/plan-review-snapshot-evidence/, so nothing bounds it. The design is §6's, which asks for the whole result to be persisted, so this is an observation about the store's lifetime rather than a defect in this implementation.
findings.summary: The persisted store keeps one file per distinct snapshot content digest, holding that snapshot's whole prose, and nothing ever removes one; reckon/crew/gc.py sweeps the pick-input and ledger caches but not reckon's persisted-memo cache directory.
